cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Drag a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') from the product list and verify that the drag event successfully captures the product's title ('product-title-1') and price ('product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Drop product item into drop area to update cart display
cases.description: Drag a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') and drop it into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the cart display automatically updates with the product title appearing in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Drop repeated products into drop area to increment quantity
cases.description: Drag and drop the same product item (data-testid='product-item-1') multiple times into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the system supports repeated products and increments the quantity accordingly in .box1.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price for cart items
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly sums the prices of single or multiple products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displays it in the div with id='allMoney'.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements adequately, maintain distinct scenarios, and present no blockers to testability.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1: Normal scenario includes dragging a product item (e.g., product-item-1) and successfully capturing the product title (product-title-1) and price (product-price-1) via the drag event transfer. Edge scenario involves verifying that the drag event correctly sets data for transfer when interacting with defined draggable product li elements. Unsupported negative cases such as testing non-draggable elements are removed. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3: Normal scenario involves dropping product items (product-item-1, product-item-2) into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'), updating the cart display with product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, and quantity in .box1. Edge and abnormal scenarios include dropping repeated products to ensure quantity increments properly, and dropping invalid elements that are not part of the product list. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5: Normal scenario includes calculating the total price of all items in the cart, formatting it to two decimal places with the currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displaying it in <div id='allMoney'>. Edge scenarios involve calculating the total with either a single item or multiple items combined into a single robust test case, alongside empty cart totals.
